title: Care Assistant
company: Avon Search & Selection Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Care Assistant - Full Time (Days) - Luxury Home Situated in 3 Acres - AV2035

37.5 Hours per Week

Location: Guildford, Surrey

Pay: £13.90 per hour (paid breaks included)

About the Role

We are recruiting a dedicated Care Assistant (Days) to join a luxury, family-run 35-bed residential and dementia care home set within three acres of beautiful Surrey countryside.

This elegant 1920s country house provides long-term residential and specialist dementia care for people aged 65 and above. In addition to permanent care, the service also offers respite, convalescent and day care, making it a well-regarded and trusted part of the local community.

Occupying an elevated position, the home enjoys remarkable countryside views while remaining conveniently located just two miles from Guildford town centre, allowing residents to stay connected with community life.

The original building has been thoughtfully converted, retaining charming period features. Bedrooms are light, airy and en-suite, overlooking landscaped gardens and surrounding countryside. Residents are encouraged to personalise their rooms, supporting a genuine home-from-home environment.

As a Care Assistant on days (37.5 hours per week), you will play a vital role in ensuring residents feel safe, comfortable and supported throughout the day. You will provide high-quality, person-centred care while promoting dignity, independence, privacy and choice.

About the Home
- Luxury 1920s country house with retained period features
- Set within three acres of landscaped grounds
- Elevated position with stunning countryside views
- 35-bed residential and dementia care setting
- Respite, convalescent and day care services available
- Spacious, light and airy en-suite bedrooms
- Family-run environment with a strong person-centred ethos
- Located just two miles from Guildford town centre

Key Responsibilities
- Provide high-quality, person-centred care to residents
- Support residents with personal care, mobility and daily routines
- Assist with meals, activities and maintaining residents' comfort throughout the day
- Support residents to participate in activities and social interaction
- Maintain accurate care records and documentation
- Respond promptly to residents' needs and requests
- Promote a safe, comfortable and supportive daytime environment
- Work collaboratively with the wider care team

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in a care setting (preferred but not essential)
- NVQ Level 2 in Health & Social Care (desirable)
- A compassionate and caring nature
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team
- Good communication and teamwork skills
- A genuine passion for supporting older people

Benefits & Perks
- £13.90 per hour
- 37.5-hour full-time contract
- Paid breaks
- Free on-site parking
- Supportive, stable team environment
- Beautiful countryside working setting
- Opportunity to make a meaningful difference every shift

To Apply

Please contact Lauren on or email to discuss this opportunity.

title: Female Support Worker
description:
On the search for your next social care role, or thinking about switching things up for a career that actually feels rewarding? We'd love to chat!

New to social care? No worries at all - we'll train you up with loads of accredited and award-winning training programmes, totally free, including the Health and Social Care Diploma to give your career a proper boost.
- Female Support Worker
- Caterham.
- £25,845 per annum (pro rata)
- Full time hours available (39 hours per week)

We're looking for Female Support Workers to join us in Caterham. You'll be part of a small team of 8, supporting 5 lovely ladies with learning disabilities, epilepsy and autism. They're all mad about music and would really appreciate someone with brilliant communication skills. Plus, they're absolute fans of pamper sessions - nails, facials, you name it! It'd be ace if you've got some experience working with adults who have learning disabilities and challenging behaviours, but honestly, it's not essential.

No two days are the same, but here's what you might get up to!
- Helping the people we support get stuck into day-to-day activities and making the most of what's happening in the community and beyond.
- Supporting social activities and helping them keep in touch with family and mates.
- Lending a hand with managing finances.
- Keeping their home nice and tidy, plus doing the food shop.
- Providing and encouraging personal care.
- And most importantly, actually enjoying what you do!

What's in it for you?
- Early Pay - grab your wages quicker if you need to.
- We'll pay for your enhanced DBS.
- Flexible working.
- Paid annual leave (pro rata).
- Access to brilliant training that'll help you level up your career.
- Contributory pension scheme with life assurance.
- Shopping discounts via Blue Light Card and The Bene£its website.
- Recommend a mate scheme - bag yourself up to £500.
- Free and confidential 24/7 access to the health portal, counselling and support.

Sound good? Hit that apply button - we're buzzing to hear from you!

As part of our commitment to the "Disability Confident Scheme", candidates who declare a disability, and meet the key criteria for this role, will be given the opportunity to demonstrate their abilities at the interview stage.

There is a genuine occupational requirement for the holder of this post to be female in accordance with the Equality Act 2010

title: Support Worker
description:
Support Worker

Chobham, Surrey

£25,845 per annum (pro rata)

Full time hours available (39 hours per week)

Avenues is a community where people smile, laugh, grow and achieve great things.

We know that well-supported people support people well to do their very best for the people we support and achieve our vision.

We are currently recruiting for a support worker to join our team in out Chobham service, providing tailored support to people with learning disabilities, brain injuries and autism, some of the people we support are non-verbal and there is also potential challenging behaviours. This role does require flexibility with the ability to work days and nights depending on the needs of the rota.

Typical shift patterns: 7/8am-2pm, 2pm-9pm, 8:45pm-7:15am and Sleep INS 9pm-6:30am

No two days are the same but your day might look like this!
- Supporting our people to be engaged in all day to day living activities, including making full use of their community and beyond.
- Supporting our people with social activities, and connecting with family and friends.
- Supporting the management of our people's finances.
- Keeping our people's home clean and fresh, and going shopping.
- Providing, and encouraging, personal care.
- And enjoying what you do!

Experience in social care is not essential, we provide a full range of accredited and award winning training programmes at no cost to yourself, including the Health and Social Care Diploma that will really support your career progression.

Benefits you can expect!
- Early Pay - ability to access your earnings more frequently if you wish.
- Paid enhanced DBS.
- Flexible working.
- Paid annual leave (pro rata).
- Access to high quality training that supports your career development.

Support Worker - people-person? Love making someone's day? You already have what it takes to start a rewarding career in care - where your natural skills really make a difference.

title: Support Worker
description:
Support Worker - Chertsey
£25,845 per year (pro rata) / Full time 39 hours a week

Having a full UK manual driving licence would be great for this role, as it really helps with getting out and about with the people we support

We're on the lookout for passionate and caring Support Workers with some experience to join our brilliant team at our 12-bed residential service in Chertsey. Right now, we've got 4 men and 8 women living with us, mostly needing 2 to 1 support, with some requiring 3 to 1. It's fair to say the support needs are pretty high here - there's manual handling involved, wheelchair users, and personal care support.

Person Centred Active Support is at the heart of everything we do, and we're looking for like-minded support workers to join us in supporting young adults with:
- Autism / Learning disabilities
- Physical disabilities
- Dementia
- Behaviours that challenge

No two days are the same, but you'll be:
- Supporting people to live independently and enjoy their everyday activities
- Encouraging social connections with family, friends, and the local community
- Helping out with finances, household tasks, and shopping
- Providing respectful, person-centred personal care
- Most importantly - creating those brilliant moments of joy and achievement!

At Avenues, we know that when our teams feel valued and supported, they create the best possible outcomes for the people we support. If you're looking for your next role in social care - we'd love to hear from you!

What's in it for you?
- Early Pay - get your hands on your earnings before payday
- Fully paid, enhanced DBS
- Flexible working patterns
- Paid annual leave (pro rata)
- Loads of training and opportunities to progress your career
- Contributory pension scheme with life assurance
- Discounts on shopping, holidays, and loads more via Blue Light Card and our Benefits website
- Recommend a Friend scheme - earn up to £500
- 24/7 health and wellbeing support, including confidential counselling

Join Avenues - where people smile, laugh, grow, and achieve great things together.

We celebrate diversity and welcome everyone!

title: Support Worker
description:
Looking for a job that feels good? Become a Support Worker with Avenues - Addlestone

Support Workers - full time hours
£25,845 per year (pro rata)

Full UK manual driving license and business insurance essential

If you're ready for a career where you can make a real difference, meet amazing people, and go home knowing you've helped someone live life their way - we'd love to hear from you!

At Avenues, people smile, laugh, grow, and achieve together. We believe happy, well-supported staff help people live their best lives - and that's what we're all about.

We are looking for Support Workers to work with us in Addlestone, supporting young adults who have learning disabilities, autism and behaviours that challenge. This will be across three 24 hour homes and supporting individuals within their own homes and their community.

This role within Addlestone Community covers; Addlestone, Chertsey and Woking areas. Staff member must drive and have own vehicle with business insurance.

What You'll Be Doing:

Every day's different, but your role could include:
- Supporting adults with learning disabilities, autism, epilepsy, or physical disabilities to live independently
- Helping people with everyday tasks like shopping, cooking, or managing money
- Encouraging people to connect with friends, family, and the community
- Providing personal care (with dignity and respect)
- Making each day meaningful - and having fun while you do it!

New to care? Don't worry! We'll give you all the training you need - including free, nationally recognised qualifications to help your career grow.

What You'll Get:
- Early Pay - access your wages before payday
- Paid enhanced DBS (so no cost to you)
- Flexible working to suit your lifestyle
- Paid annual leave (pro rata)
- Award-winning training to boost your skills
- Pension scheme and life assurance
- Discounts on shopping, holidays, and more (Blue Light Card & Benefits site)
- Recommend a Friend bonus - up to £500
- 24/7 wellbeing support and counselling

We believe everyone deserves the chance to shine. If you have a disability and meet the basic job criteria, we'll guarantee you an interview under the Disability Confident Scheme.

Sounds good? Apply today - your feel-good career starts here!

We reserve the right to close a vacancy before the closing date in the event of an overwhelming response or a change in business priorities.
